title: Range of sine
text: The function $$y=\sin(2x)$$ has an amplitude of $$1$$. This eliminates Graph B (which has an amplitude of 2) and Graph C (which is unbounded).

title: Period
text: As calculated above, the period of this function is $$\pi.$$ Graph A completes one cycle in $$2\pi, $$ while Graph D is compressed and completes one full wave cycle every $$\pi.$$
